description:
The Level-2G (L2G) Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO)-Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) Merged Deep Blue Aerosol 0.25 x 0.25-degree Gridded dataset is part of a 12-product suite produced by an Earth Science Research from Operational Geostationary Satellite Systems (ESROGSS)-funded project. The 12 products in this project include nine derived from three Geostationary Earth Observation (GEO) instruments and three from merged data from GEO and Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) instruments as summarized in the following table:

| Platform | Instrument | Temporal Cadence | Spatial Res. | Product |
| :-------: | :----------: | :------------------: | :-----------: | :-------: |
| GOES-16 | Advanced Baseline Imager | 30 Min. | 10 km | AERDB_L2_ABI_G16 |
| GOES-17 | Advanced Baseline Imager | 30 Min. | 10 km | AERDB_L2_ABI_G17 |
| Himawari-8 | Advanced Himawari Imager | 30 Min. | 10 km | AERDB_L2_AHI_H08 |
| GOES-16 | Advanced Baseline Imager | Daily | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_D3_ABI_G16 |
| GOES-17 | Advanced Baseline Imager | Daily | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_D3_ABI_G17 |
| Himawari-8 | Advanced Himawari Imager | Daily | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_D3_AHI_H08 |
| GOES-16 | Advanced Baseline Imager | Monthly | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_M3_ABI_G16 |
| GOES-17 | Advanced Baseline Imager | Monthly | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_M3_ABI_G17 |
| Himawari-8 | Advanced Himawari Imager | Monthly | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_M3_AHI_H08 |
| **Multiple*** | **ABI, AHI, VIIRS, MODIS*** | **30 Min.** | **0.25˚ x 0.25˚** | **AERDB_L2G_GEOLEO_Merged** |
| Multiple* | ABI, AHI, VIIRS, MODIS* | Daily | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_D3_GEOLEO_Merged |
| Multiple* | ABI, AHI, VIIRS, MODIS* | Monthly | 1˚ x 1˚ | AERDB_M3_GEOLEO_Merged |

\*  includes G16-ABI, G17-ABI, H08-AHI, SNPP-VIIRS, NOAA20-VIIRS, Terra MODIS & Aqua MODIS

Each L2G GEO-LEO Merged Deep Blue Aerosol product contains gridded Aerosol Optical Thickness (AOT) at 550 nm reference wavelength, derived from seven merged GEO-LEO AOT layers (G16-ABI, G17-ABI, H08-AHI, SNPP-VIIRS, NOAA20-VIIRS, Terra MODIS and Aqua MODIS) and from each of the individual (three GEO and four LEO) instrument sources. Each L2G aggregated datafile is spatially comprised of a 0.25˚ x 0.25˚ horizontal grid that exists for every 30 minutes. This represents a 30-minute Deep Blue best-estimate AOT from each of the seven sources besides an error-weighted merged AOT layer. This first release of these products spans from May 2019 through April 2020 with a potential to generate additional temporal coverage in the future.

Each L2G GEO-LEO Merged datafile contains the following Science Data Sets (SDS):

**GEO-LEO Merged Group SDS**
1. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Count_Land
2. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Count_Land_Ocean
3. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Count_Ocean
4. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Land
5. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Land_Ocean
6. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Maximum_Land
7. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Maximum_Land_Ocean
8. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Maximum_Ocean
9. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Minimum_Land
10. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Minimum_Land_Ocean
11. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Minimum_Ocean
12. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Ocean
13. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Standard_Deviation_Land
14. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Standard_Deviation_Land_Ocean
15. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Standard_Deviation_Ocean
16. Solar_Zenith_Angletion

 **GEO SDSs (G16/ABI, G17/ABI, H08/AHI) & LEO SDSs (T/A: MODIS, SNPP/NOAA-20: VIIRS)**
1. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Count_Land
2. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Count_Land_Ocean
3. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Count_Ocean
4. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Expected_Uncertainty_Land
5. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Expected_Uncertainty_Land_Ocean
6. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Expected_Uncertainty_Ocean
7. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Land
8. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Land_Ocean
9. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Ocean
10. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Standard_Deviation_Land
11. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Standard_Deviation_Land_Ocean
12. Aerosol_Optical_Thickness_550_Standard_Deviation_Ocean
13. Relative_Azimuth_Angle
14. Solar_Zenith_Angle
15. Viewing_Zenith_Angle
